appDescription: An in-car voice docent that tells short stories about places along the navigation route and pauses while the driver needs to focus.

function.name: REPEAT_DOCENT_STORY
function.description: Repeat the sentence of the place story that the docent is telling or has just finished telling.

function.name: ADD_SUGGESTED_STOP
function.description: Add the place that the docent has just suggested to visit as a waypoint of the current navigation route.

function.name: SET_STUDY_LANGUAGE
function.description: Turn on learning mode so the docent tells the place stories in the language the user is studying and asks a short review quiz, or turn it off.

language.description: The language the user is studying, or off to stop learning mode.
